summary: First-finish smoke test for AI Medical Diagnosis Assistant. All 16 backend checks and full frontend E2E flow (landing → register → dashboard → diagnose → report → reports list → logout → protected-route redirect) pass. AI predict endpoint returns 3-4 diseases with confidence, causes, medicines, home remedies, diet, precautions, and doctor guidance. Emergency warning correctly populated for chest pain + shortness of breath.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates patient, returns JWT + user (role=patient)
GET /api/symptoms returns list including Fever, Cough, Headache
POST /api/predict with cold symptoms returns 4 diseases with all required fields (name/confidence/description/possible_causes/recommended_medicines/home_remedies/diet/precautions/when_to_see_doctor)
POST /api/predict with Chest Pain + Shortness of Breath returns non-empty emergency_warning (AI-generated)
Frontend: Landing page has hero-cta-register and hero-cta-login
Frontend: Register form submits and lands on /dashboard
Frontend: /diagnose supports symptom checkboxes, manual add, and submit navigates to /reports/:id
Frontend: Report detail renders top disease, symptoms, general advice sections
Frontend: nav-logout clears session and returns to /login
notes: POST /api/predict response is wrapped as {report: {...}} rather than the report object directly; frontend/tests must read response.data.report.
AI (Claude Sonnet 4.5) predictions returned in ~15-25s; consider showing a longer loading state hint.
Test patient email used: uitest_<ts>@test.com; admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for these flows.
